title: Jason White's 18 Straight Completions vs. Nebraska, 2004
question: How many passes in a row did Jason White complete against Nebraska in 2004?
answer: Jason White completed 18 consecutive passes, a school record, in Oklahoma's 30-3 win over Nebraska on November 13, 2004. He finished 29 of 35 for 383 yards and three touchdowns.
summary: On Nov. 13, 2004, Jason White hit a school-record 18 straight passes and threw for 383 yards as No. 2 Oklahoma beat Nebraska 30-3 in Norman.
body: On Saturday night, November 13, 2004, Oklahoma closed its home schedule by hosting Nebraska at Memorial Stadium in Norman. The Sooners came in ranked second and unbeaten, and the old Big Eight rivals left with a lopsided result: Oklahoma 30, Nebraska 3.

The star was sixth-year senior quarterback Jason White. By the AP account, he started the night just 3 of 8, then found a groove that did not break. He completed 18 passes in a row, a school record, and ended the game 29 of 35 for 383 yards and three touchdowns, including a 4-yard pass to Brandon Jones and a 23-yard strike to Mark Bradley.

He had to carry the offense because Adrian Peterson, the freshman star, was playing through a dislocated left shoulder from the previous week against Texas A&M. Peterson managed 58 yards on 15 carries, his lowest total of the season after nine straight 100-yard games to open his career, and Kejuan Jones started in his place.

Nebraska's only points came on a 39-yard field goal by David Dyches as time expired. Oklahoma moved to 10-0 overall and 7-0 in the Big 12, and Nebraska fell to 5-5, 3-4 in league play. White went on to finish third in the 2004 Heisman voting.
